protocol.distribution: Deliberately curated diagnostic words, not natural text and not independent human gold
protocol.rootCanonicalization: Seated hamza أإؤئ maps to ء only in the secondary canonical-root metric; exact-root agreement also retained
protocol.scoring: Accepted values scored separately by field; top-3 means at least one candidate matches that field. No full-analysis or gold accuracy claim.

limitations: Two blind AI annotations and one separate AI adjudication, not human review. Same-family models share knowledge and failure modes; agent separation is not independent human evidence. NOT HUMAN GOLD and never eligible to satisfy human-gold promotion gates.

The adjudicator used frozen inputs, both original blind annotations, the public contract/schema and AIReview interface/validation, plus targeted primary dictionary checks. No model predictions, teacher labels, generated training data or fixture labels were used. Independence here means procedural separation from those task artifacts, not unknown pretraining corpora.

Only rejection, root, coarse POS and segmentation accepted sets are labeled. Pattern and features are deliberately omitted. Fields are scored separately; their Cartesian product is not a set of mutually compatible complete analyses. No exhaustive-coverage, natural-text accuracy or calibration claim is made.

The inputs are deliberately curated isolated words. Unvocalized standard/classical readings can coexist, but arbitrary names, dialect spellings, rare vocabulary and every productive reading are not exhaustively enumerated. Supplied diacritics constrain readings even though the initial architecture does not learn vowel distinctions.

Canonical roots use bare ء for seated hamza radicals, expanded geminates and underlying weak radicals. Borrowed proper names and genuinely rootless grammatical readings use null. Arabic-derived proper names and lexical quantifier كل retain lexical roots. طمأنينة uses provisional synchronic طمءن; historical/traditional alternatives are audited, not accepted as interchangeable.

POS follows the lexical host rather than attached clitics. Participles with credible substantive and descriptive uses may accept noun/adjective. Generic ellipsis does not automatically add noun to every adjective. Intensive adjectival readings for وبكتابهم and كتابان remain provisional inferences requiring human attestation/POS review.

The contract specifies span types and coverage but not all linguistic granularity. Derivational prefixes, imperfective person prefixes, internal broken-plural material and weak-root allomorphs remain in stem. Productive gender/number/case/subject-agreement endings use inflectional_suffix; pronominal_enclitic is reserved for object/possessor/complement pronouns. Traditional subject-pronoun terminology is not accepted as a competing label here.

Lexical/masdar ة may remain in stem or use derivational_suffix. Productive feminine agreement may use inflectional_suffix. Lexical gender alone does not justify an inflectional suffix. Construct ت follows the corresponding lexical or agreement analysis. Agreement and mood endings may be bundled or separated where explicitly listed; no blanket union of all ending labels is permitted.

Offsets are original-input JavaScript UTF-16 code units, end-exclusive. Spans cover every code unit once and attached marks stay with their preceding letter. Support alif stays with its plural suffix; accusative-support alif may be an inflectional span. Standalone grammatical tokens use stem because the schema requires one.

Fused في and أنا, and attention-particle allocation in هذا, remain low-confidence surface conventions. These span sets cannot represent overlapping/shared letters or zero-surface morphology. They require an explicit human-approved granularity policy before use as a rigorous segmentation benchmark.

Targeted source verification supports specified lemmas/senses, not every exact inflected token. Regular imperatives, duals and derived forms are identified as AI grammatical inferences. Original annotator sources are retained for audit; their presence is not a claim that the adjudicator independently rechecked every URL.

All confidence labels are qualitative AI judgments, not probabilities. High confidence does not imply complete alternative coverage. Any future gold benchmark requires independent human annotation, adjudication and suitable split/provenance controls.
Same-family AI annotators have correlated knowledge and errors; multiple agents are not independent humans.
Curated inputs can overlap training and verification; surface-disjoint does not establish lemma-family disjointness.
Field-level accepted sets omit pattern/features and may be incomplete or permissive. This report cannot satisfy human-gold promotion gates.
